== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[You May Start Your Landing (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1282_3</code>, Virtual Block 8.2), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p2-56-You_May_Start_Your_Landing.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-youmaystartyourlanding-pre.gif]]) show the original text of [[You May Start Your Landing (V)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip. Typos kept as published (“AT-At”, “Garrrison”).
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “If 5th Marker on table, deploy on table. During your control phase, opponent loses 1 Force for each marker site you control with an AT-At (limit 1 unless [Virtual Block 2] Imperial Control on table). Once per game, may ▲ Walker Garrrison and/or 3rd Marker. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1282_3</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 8 set mark, slip number 8, original-title strip, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
